limitations: pnpm and yarn lockfiles are not accepted by the promoted frozen package graph parser
native .node addons and arbitrary node-gyp/native binary execution are unsupported
generic fs.watch/chokidar parity is not promoted
raw guest TCP/UDP and arbitrary host process creation are unsupported
minimum cross-browser versions are intentionally not frozen before browser matrix evidence

unsupportedClasses.statement: Native .node addons, node-gyp and arbitrary host-native binaries are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Arbitrary raw TCP/UDP/TLS socket semantics are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Full Linux/POSIX process, device and host-filesystem semantics are unsupported in Core 1.x.
Browser/OS/device profiles without retained evidence are unsupported and must not be marketed as supported.

requiredOpenBoundaries: P11-12 actual published OpenContainer package/bundle remains open
P11-13 browser minimum versions remain unfrozen until real matrix evidence exists
P7/P14 weak-device and long-run resource evidence remains open
P12-17 verified private vulnerability intake remains open
